bias.label: Stuck at 3,560-3,580 under 3,600; downtrend holds below 3,651

event: Fri 27 Nov: US half-day (stocks close 20:00 SAST), thin trade. Sun 29 Nov: OPEC+ meeting. Mon 30 Nov: month end. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST, with a hike almost fully priced.

bullets.title: Flat into the night
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 3,568 late on Thursday, down about 0.6% on the day, after failing to hold above 3,600 earlier (TipRanks, updated 21:15 SAST).

bullets.title: 15-month low held
bullets.text: Wednesday's low was 3,445.89, the lowest since August 2025, and Thursday's range was about 3,561-3,603 by the morning (FinanceFeeds, citing CNBC).

bullets.title: Hike almost certain
bullets.text: Hot core PCE of 3.3% and Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3% left December hike odds at about 97-99% (TipRanks, The Library citing Kitco).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields firm
bullets.text: The dollar index was about 103.8 and the US 10-year near 4.85% at Wednesday's close, which caps gold's bounces (The Library).

bullets.title: Banks split
bullets.text: HSBC warns gold could fall below 3,400 toward 3,000 if stocks drop again, while TD Securities says it is too early to call a bottom (TipRanks).

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: US markets reopen only for a half-day on Friday, so moves can be jumpy and breakouts less reliable.
